spans.s: गत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Gone, departed, passed, e.g. गता बहुतरा कांते स्वल्पा तिष्ठति यामिनी; 2. dead, deceased, K.S.iv.30; 3. gone to, arrived at; 4. being in, contained in, resting on, e.g. सभागत ‘sitting in an assembly,’ सर्वगत ‘existing everywhere’; 5. (in compounds) relating to, referring to, connected with, with regard to, वयमपि तावद्भवत्यौ सखीगतं किमपि पृच्छामः Sak.i., पुत्रगतः स्नेहः ‘love for a son,’ (pp. of गम् q.v.).
गत (II) n. 1. Going, motion, गतं तिरश्चीनमनूरुसारथेः Sis.i.2; 2. maimer of going, gait; 3. an event.

गत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Gone, departed, passed, e.g. गता बहुतरा कांते स्वल्पा तिष्ठति यामिनी; 2. dead, deceased, K.S.iv.30; 3. gone to, arrived at; 4. being in, contained in, resting on, e.g. सभागत ‘sitting in an assembly,’ सर्वगत ‘existing everywhere’; 5. (in compounds) relating to, referring to, connected with, with regard to, वयमपि तावद्भवत्यौ सखीगतं किमपि पृच्छामः Sak.i., पुत्रगतः स्नेहः ‘love for a son,’ (pp. of गम् q.v.).
गत-अक्ष a. sightless, blind.
गत-अध्वन् (I) a. 1. one who has accomplished a journey; 2. conversant, familiar with any thing.
गत-अध्वन् (II) f. the time immediately preceding new moon when a small streak of the moon is still visible (चतुर्दशीयुक्ताऽमावास्या).
गत-अनुगत n. following custom or precedent.
गत-अनुगतिक a. blindly following custom or precedent, गतानुगतिको लोको न लोकः पारमार्थिकः Panch.i.
गातानुगतिक a. (f. की) Caused by following or imitating custom or precedent.
गत-अंत a. one whose end has arrived.
गत-अर्थ a. 1. poor, indigent; 2. whose meaning is already expressed, (hence) unmeaning.
गत-असु, -जीवित, -प्राण a. expired, dead, Bg.ii.11.
गत-असु, -जीवित, -प्राण a. expired, dead, Bg.ii.11.
गत-असु, -जीवित, -प्राण a. expired, dead, Bg.ii.11.
गत-प्राण a. lifeless, dead.
गत-आगत n. 1. going and coming, reiterated motion, Bg.ix.21; 2. irregular course of the stare (in astronomy).
गत-आधि a. free from anxiety, happy.
गत-आयुस् a. decrepit, very old, near death.
गत-आर्तवा f. a woman past her courses or past child-bearing.
गत-उत्साह a. disspirited.
गत-ओजस् a. bereft of strength.
गत-कल्मष a. freed from crime or sin, purified.
गत-क्लम a. rested, refreshed.
गत-चेतन a. deprived of sense or consciousness, senseless.
गत-दिनम् ind. yesterday.
गत-प्रत्यागत a. come back again after having gone away, M.vii.186.
गत-प्रभ a. bereft of splendour, dim, faded.
गत-प्राय ??? almost gone, nearly passed away, e.g. गतप्राया रात्रिः शशिमुखि शशी शीर्यत इव.
गत-भर्तृका f. 1. a widow; 2. a woman whose husband is abroad.
गत-लक्ष्मीक a. 1. suffering losses, impoverished; 2. faded, bereft of beauty or splendour.
गत-वयस्क a. advanced in age.
गत-वर्ष m.n. past year.
गत-वैर a. at peace with, reconciled.
गत-व्यथ a. free from pain.
गत-शैशव a. past infancy.
गत-सत्व a. 1. annihilated, lifeless; 2. base.
गत-सन्नक m. an elephant out of rut.
गत-स्पृह a. indifferent to worldly pursuits.

गति f. 1. Going, moving, gait, motion, विश्वासोपगमादभिन्नगतयः Sak.i., न भिंदंति मंदां गतिमश्वमुख्यः K.S.i.11, प्रणयातिभूमिमगमन् गतिभिः Sis.ix.78, Megh.i.16, 19; 2. access, entrance, मणौ वज्रसमुत्कीर्णे सूत्र स्येवास्ति मे गतिः R.i.4; 3. scope, room, मनोरथानामगतिर्न विद्यते K.S.v.64; 4. state, condition, position, situation, परार्ध्यगतेः (पितुः) R.viii.27, मालतीकुसुमस्येव द्वे गती स्तो मनस्विनाम् Bhartr.ii.104, तिस्रो गतयो भवंति वित्तस्य ii.43; 5. means, expedient, coarse, alternative, अनुपेक्षणे द्वयी नास्त्येव नास्त्येव गतिरन्यथा Mud.iii. or कलौ नास्त्येव नास्त्येव नास्त्येव गतिरन्यथा; 6. a march, a procession; 7. an issue, an event; 8. source, origin, acquisition, एवमाचारतो दृष्ट्वा धर्मस्य मुनयो गतिम् M.i.10, Bg.ii.43; 9. knowledge, wisdom; 10. a period of life (as age, youth &c.); 11. course of events, fate, fortune; 12. recourse, refuge, asylum, गतिरात्मा तथात्मनः M.viii.84; 13. transmigration, metempsychosis; 14. a running wound, a sore; 15. the diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit (in astronomy); 16. a term for propositions and some other adverbial prefixes when immediately connected with the tenses of a verb or verbal derivatives (in gram.).
गति-अनुसर m. following the way of another.
गति-हीन a. forlorn, without refuge, helpless.
गत्वर a. (f. री) 1. Going, moving, locomotive; 2. transient, perishable, गत्वरैरसुभिः Kir.ii.19, गत्वर्यो यौवनश्रियः xi.12.
गत्वर a. (f. री) 1. Going, moving, locomotive; 2. transient, perishable, गत्वरैरसुभिः Kir.ii.19, गत्वर्यो यौवनश्रियः xi.12.
गातागतिक a. (f. की) Caused by going and coming.
गातागतिक a. (f. की) Caused by going and coming.
गातानुगतिक a. (f. की) Caused by following or imitating custom or precedent.
गातु m. 1. A song; 2. a singer; 3. a celestial chorister; 4. the male Indian cuckoo; 5. the large black bee.
गातृ m. (fem. ˚त्री) 1. A singer; 2. a Gandharva.
गात्र n. 1. The body, सा मंगलस्नानविशुद्धगात्री K.S.vii.11; 2. a limb, a member, उत्सादनं च गात्राणाम् M.ii.209; 3. the forequarter of an elephant.
गात्र-अनुलेपनी f. a fragrant unguent applied to the body.
गात्र-आवरण n. a shield.
गात्र-उत्सादन n. cleaning the person with perfumes.
गात्र-कर्षण a. emaciating the body.
गात्र-मार्जनी f. a towel.
गात्र-यष्टि f. a thin or slender body, R.vi.81.
गात्र-रुह n. the hair on the body.
गात्र-लता f. a thin and tender body.
गात्र-संकोचिन् n. the pole-cat (so called because it contracts its body in order to spring).
गात्र-संप्लव m. a small bird, the diver.
